term: objective or real possibility in the Kantian criticism
definition: Possibility of an object or its nonexistence, as distinct from consistency of a thought. In the cited criticism, mere noncontradiction does not establish it; objective application requires the conditions of cognition. The definition is deliberately a distinction, not a complete reduction of possibility to observed actuality.
